route_reason: The question asks the student to identify a shaded region on an outline map of India, which is exactly what the map route produces with shaded and labelled regions.

spec.shaded_region: Assam, in the northeast of India, shaded in one solid colour
spec.other_regions: All other states unshaded, with no names or labels
spec.boundaries: Clear state boundary lines; the shaded state must be recognisable by its shape and position
spec.extras: Optional small north arrow in a corner; no legend, no title that names a state

must_show: An outline map of India with its state boundaries drawn. Exactly one state, Assam (in the northeast), is shaded in a solid colour. The shaded state has no name label, and the other states are unshaded and unlabelled, so the student must identify the shaded state from its shape and position. Include a simple compass arrow or latitude/longitude reference if helpful, and no other text beyond the question.
must_not_show: The name of the shaded state (Assam)
Any label or text naming any state
Any hint such as tea plantations, tea leaves or a tea cup
Any indication of which option is correct
